volume.title: Faceless
volume.author: Cuttlefish That Loves Diving
volume.title_meaning: The title Faceless refers not just to Klein's promotion to sequence 6 Faceless, but also to the faceless people who lived and died on East Backlund as some of the backbone members of society. Although their stories were rarely known, their contributions were invaluable. The spotlight on Old Kohler and Liz's family was the author's attempt at portraying some of the stories of these faceless people. The title also refers to Klein's changing identity, how he is not really Sherlock Moriarty, nor Klein Moretti, but Zhou Mingrui. He has a different mask for every situation, so in the end, his face does not capture his true self.
volume.synopsis: In Backlund, Klein took the identity of Sherlock Moriarty, a private detective. Because of Ian Wright's commission, he was involved in a conspiracy conflict with Intis intelligence and MI9. Klein hired Sharron for three-days as a bodyguard. He killed Rosago with the help of Sharron and obtained the potion formulas from sequence 7 to 5 of the Fool Pathway. After discovering the conspiracy of the descent of the True Creator through Lanevus, Klein let Miss Justice inform the Church of the Evernight Goddess. Although Lanevus fled into the sewers, Klein successfully achieved the first part of his revenge plan by killing Lanevus. Klein advanced to Sequence 7 Magician not long after. He then successfully stole the Black Emperor Card, one of the Cards of Blasphemy, in Roselle Memorial Exhibition. Klein killed Capim, a human trafficker, and gained the name The Hero Bandit Black Emperor and with other grand performances, he successfully digested the Magician potion before advancing to sequence 6 Faceless. However, this alerted the authorities to the presence of some mysterious Tarot card related organisation as he'd left tarot cards on the scene again. Then, he became involved in another plot of Ince Zangwill. He let Miss Justice inform the Church of the Evernight Goddess about the presence of Trissy Cheek. Klein interrupted the True Creator's attempted descent ritual and barely managed to escape from Mr. A through a chance encounter with Mr. Azik and the help of '0-17' Angel of Concealment. Meanwhile, the Lady Despair spread plagues smog hovered over the Backlund, resulting in over 21,000 people in East Borough dying. Klein suspected this Great Smog was a big plot coordinated with the royal family and military faction for unknown reasons. In the new year, Klein changed his identity once again and went to the Sonia Sea to find traces of mermaids in order to advance to Sequence 5 Marionettist.

timeline_of_major_events.event: Klein arrived at Backlund and met Ian Wright on the metro. Klein rented Unit 15 Minsk Street under the pseudonym: Sherlock Moriarty the private detective.
Tarot Club 12th meeting. Audrey promoted to the Telepathist.
Ian Wright entrusted Klein a commission to look for Detective Zreal.
Klein found detective Zreal's corpse. Fors and Xio borrowed Viscount Glaint's book. Xio mindlessly recited The Fool's honorable title. At night, she dreams of the mysterious gray fog.

Meursault visited Klein to look for Ian, Klein refused. Klein invested on the bicycle. In the evening Meursault attacked and was killed by Klein. Xio purchased the Sheriff potion formula and find someone to purify her soul. A member of MI9 asked her to becomes his informant.
Klein went to the Bravehearts Bar to buy a gun. Maric rejected Klein's employment.

Tarot Club 13th meeting. Klein went to Old Mister Eye of Wisdom's Gathering. He sold Meursault's Beyonder characteristic and bought the black ear of the Listener. After divining its origin, the black ear suddenly crumbled, and turned into a charm. Klein named it Language of Foulness.
Audrey entrusted Fors and Xio to find someone to assassinate Intis ambassador Bakerland. Mr. A accepted the mission from Fors and Xio. Maric introduced Sharron as a bodyguard to Klein.

Klein paid 1,000 pounds to hire Sharron as a three-day bodyguard. Ian visited Klein and told the whole story. Bakerland assassinated by Mr. A. Klein and Sharron killed Rosago. Klein obtained the potion formula of Sequence 7, 6, and 5 of the Seer Pathway.
Millet Carter commissioned Klein to explore the underground structure on Williams Street. Klein and Sharron explored the underground structure on Williams Street.
Tarot Club 14th meeting.
Audrey entrusted Xio to find Lanevus's whereabout. Mike Joseph entrusted Klein to protect him for investigation in East Borough.
Klein and Sharron blew up the underground structure. Audrey reported the clue about Lanevus to Klein.
In East Borough, Klein met Old Kohler and invited him to have lunch. Xio saw Lanevus at the dock union. Klein disguised as a reporter enter the dock union to confirm the whereabouts of Lanevus.
Main article: Death of Lanevus. Tarot Club 15th meeting. The City of Silver found the True Creator's Temple.
Klein promoted to the Magician. During a Blood Moon, Fors prayed to the Fool. Fors joined the Tarot Club.

Darkwill promoted to the Beast Tamer. Isengard Stanton asked Klein to cooperate to solve the serial murder case. Klein completed the commission of Father Utravsky and obtained the Apothecary potion formula and the Master Key.
Tarot Club 16th meeting.
Klein stole the Black Emperor Card of Blasphemy from Roselle Memorial Exhibition. Klein escaped from Bernadette Gustav and encountered the Serial Killer Devil Dog.
Klein opens the Black Emperor Card of Blasphemy.
Klein visited the Quelaag Club and was asked by Aaron to help cure his bad luck.
Klein buys 50 bullets at Old Mister Eye of Wisdom's Gathering. Klein obtains the Apprentice, Trickmaster, and Astrologer formulas.
Tarot Club 17th meeting.
Klein helped Sharron and Maric hunt the members of Rose School of Thought.

Ikanser Bernard used the Sealed Artifact 2-111 to investigate Klein's fight the previous night. Derrick faked losing control and was put in the spire. He met Uddel, a former team captain who was imprisoned in the tower for 42 years. He mentioned Amon to Derrick.

Tarot Club 18th meeting. The parasited Uddel lost control and was killed by Colin Iliad. Derrick prayed to the Fool. Klein discovered and resolved Amon's parasite. Leonard promoted to the Nightmare. Klein found Emlyn's White family home at Unit 48 Riverbay Avenue. Alger fully digested the Seafarer potion.

Klein prepared a Desi pie breakfast when he helped Ma'am Mary brought by Mrs. Stelyn to clear up a threatening letter caused by politics of the National Atmospheric Pollution Council. Klein divined the origin of the Biological Poison Bottle, a mystical item byproduct of a Planter Pathway Rampager's fatal failed experiment. Audrey received psychology lessons from Escalante. In the evening, to fulfill the White family's missing person's request given by Detective Stuart, Klein went to the Harvest Church and obtained permission for Emlyn White's freedom. Klein learned about Emlyn's habit to do volunteer work at the Harvest Church, which started today. He also learned about Emlyn's family's expertise in potions.

Klein began studying the Book of Secrets. Klein better understood the 'performance' and 'audience' of the Acting Method. Klein had a small lunch meet with Detective Stuart. Emlyn visited Klein at 15 Minsk Street in his brown clerical robes. Klein had Emlyn use mystical medicine to heal Mrs. Doris, the mother of Jurgen Cooper.
Klein investigated the disappearance of Daisy and found Capim's villa. Main article: The Hero Bandit. Fors first met Mr. Lawrence of the Abraham Family.
Klein entered Aaron Ceres's dream and took Will Auceptin's paper crane. Audrey was invited to join the Psychology Alchemists.

Tarot Club 19th meeting. Derrick borrowed the All-Black Eye from Mr. World and encountered Darc, one of the exploration team members who entered the True Creator's temple. Mr. A learned about The Fool though Elder Lovia.

Klein and Aaron found Will Auceptin's corpse in the Grimm Cemetery. Leonard officially became a Red Gloves of Soest's squad. Fors met Lawrence again at the Grimm Cemetery. Lawrence asked Fors to help him send the Leymano's Travels and his Beyonder Characteristic to Dorian Gray at Pritz Harbor after his death. Mr. A announced the bounty for the Fool's believers at the Beyonder gathering.

Klein and Framis Cage bought the Backlund Bike Company's share. Audrey joined the Psychology Alchemists. Susie promoted to the Telepathist. Isengard, Kaslana, and Klein fought Jason Beria, but the latter fled. Ikanser took Arrodes to check Klein's house.

Klein, Isengard, Kaslana, and Ikanser searched the home of suspect Patrick Jason. Jason Beria assassinated Pallas Negan after successfully conspired to lead Ace Snake away from the Holy Wind Cathedral. Leonard wore the Sealed Artifact 1-42 and chased after Jason Beria to the sewers. But he found that Jason was already killed by the Hero Bandit Black Emperor. Klein fully digested the Magician potion.
Fors fully digested the Apprentice potion. Fors became the student of Dorian Gray Abraham and she had to drank a second Apprentice potion he concocted in front of him.
Klein sold the clue of Amon Family's Underground Tomb to the Machinery Hivemind. Talim Dumont died. Talim's Funeral day to be held at 9 am. on December 21st.
Edessak Augustus entrusted Klein to investigate the death of Talim. Tarot Club 25th meeting.

Talim's Funeral day at 9 am., announced in Chapter 437. Derrick was assigned to explore the True Creator's temple led by Chief Colin. Arrodes broadcasted the Machinery Hivemind's exploration of Amon Family's Underground Tomb for Klein.

Klein promoted to the Faceless. MI9 asked Xio to pay attention to the seller of the Sheriff's characteristics. Benson passed the first round of the Civil Servant Unified Examination and planned to move to Backlund with Melissa.

Colin's exploration team arrived at the True Creator's temple and found Jack. They got trapped in a time loop. An Evil Spirit at the underground structure tempted Klein and Sharron to find their blood descendants to help them out of trouble. Nibbs Odora asked Emlyn to pray to The Fool.
Derrick noticed the time loop after entering the gray fog. Then he found a way to break the time loop. Tarot Club 26th meeting. Emlyn prayed to the Fool.

Emlyn joined the Tarot Club. Main articles: Great Smog of Backlund and Battle at the Underground Ruin. Klein finished his lease on Minsk Street, but did not return there and prepared to move out of Backlund. Klein wrote to the Machinery Hivemind to describe the massive underground ruin and had to be tested.
Audrey received a main ingredient from Fors.

Klein had specially gone to Sharron and obtained a new identity, Gehrman Sparrow, through her circle for 8 pounds documents. Klein pinched out his Gehrman Sparrow appearance. For the 10 percent stake in the bike company, Klein found an opportunity to meet with Isengard Stanton and signed a legal agreement to entrust the matter to him.
Since the Great Smog, Emlyn had been working in the Harvest Church to provide medicines for the gathered sick while assisting Utravsky. Audrey was introduced into adulthood by the queen.
Klein received his new identification card.

Klein wrote an epitaph for Old Kohler while visiting the newly opened cemetery for him and Liv. Benson and Melissa arrived in Backlund and coincidentally saw Gehrman Sparrow from afar. As Gehrman Sparrow, Klein left Backlund and headed to Pritz Harbor.
